title: 🌻 Sami tips the leaky can over his sunflower... what happens now? #kidsstories #shorts
title_alts: 🌻 Can Sami water a thirsty sunflower when his only can leaks? #kidsstories #shorts
🌻 Nobody told Sami his only can leaks... so how does he water it? #kidsstories #shorts
description_hook: Sami's sunflower has one evening left to drink, and the only watering can in the house has a crack along its base. What he takes off his own feet changes everything.

characters.name: Sami
characters.description: six years old, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, red rain boots

scenes.narration: Tonight Sami's sunflower needed water, or it would wilt. He grabbed the leaky can.
scenes.caption: आज रात सामी के सूरजमुखी को पानी चाहिए था, वरना वह मुरझा जाता। उसने टपकता कैन उठाया।
scenes.image_brief: Sami, a six-year-old boy with short black hair, a yellow t-shirt and red rain boots, crouches beside a tall drooping sunflower in a clay pot on a small back veranda, holding a dented green watering can. The soil in the pot is pale and cracked dry. Warm orange light of late evening across the tiles.

scenes.narration: Sami tilted it over the pot. Water ran out the bottom. Drip, drip, one more drop, he begged.
scenes.caption: सामी ने कैन गमले पर झुकाया। पानी नीचे से बह गया। टप, टप, एक बूँद और, वह बोला।
scenes.image_brief: Sami, a six-year-old boy with short black hair, a yellow t-shirt and red rain boots, tilts the dented green watering can over the sunflower pot on the veranda while a stream of water escapes through a crack in the base of the can and spreads across the tiles. Evening light, his face puzzled.

scenes.narration: He plugged the crack with his thumb. Water squirted sideways. Count the drips with me.
scenes.caption: उसने दरार पर अंगूठा दबाया। पानी बगल से छूट गया। मेरे साथ बूँदें गिनो।
scenes.image_brief: Sami, a six-year-old boy with short black hair, a yellow t-shirt and red rain boots, presses his thumb hard against the crack in the green watering can while a thin jet of water squirts out sideways and darkens his shorts. The drooping sunflower pot stands beside him on the veranda at dusk.

scenes.narration: The crack split wide open. The can emptied onto the path. The tap was locked.
scenes.caption: दरार चौड़ी हो गई। पूरा कैन रास्ते पर खाली हो गया। नल पर ताला था।
scenes.image_brief: The dented green watering can lies on its side on the veranda tiles with a wide split along its base and a long wet stain running down the path, while Sami, a six-year-old boy with short black hair, a yellow t-shirt and red rain boots, stares at it with empty hands. A padlocked brass garden tap on the wall behind him. Fading blue dusk light.

scenes.narration: Sami tugged off a rain boot and filled it at the sink. Drip, drip, one more drop.
scenes.caption: सामी ने एक रेन बूट उतारा और उसे नल पर भर लिया। टप, टप, एक बूँद और।
scenes.image_brief: Sami, a six-year-old boy with short black hair and a yellow t-shirt, stands on one bare foot at a kitchen sink holding a red rain boot upright under the running tap so water fills the boot to its brim, the other red boot still on his left foot. Warm yellow kitchen light, his mouth set in concentration.

scenes.narration: Three boot-loads later the soil turned dark. The sunflower lifted its head. Say it with me.
scenes.caption: तीन बूट भरने के बाद मिट्टी गीली हो गई। सूरजमुखी ने सिर उठाया। मेरे साथ कहो।
scenes.image_brief: Sami, a six-year-old boy with short black hair, a yellow t-shirt and one red rain boot on his left foot, pours water out of the other red boot into the sunflower pot on the veranda; the soil is dark and glossy with water and the big sunflower head has lifted upright. Soft blue evening light with a warm lamp glow spilling from the doorway.

scenes.narration: Sami leaned close to the sunflower. Drip, drip, one more drop.
scenes.caption: सामी सूरजमुखी के बिलकुल पास झुका। टप, टप, एक बूँद और।
scenes.image_brief: Sami, a six-year-old boy with short black hair, a yellow t-shirt and red rain boots back on his feet, kneels with his face right next to the upright sunflower on the veranda, whispering to its petals, the empty red boot tipped over on the tiles beside him. Last warm light of the day, calm and happy mood.

title: 🌊 Nina piles dry sand fast... but whose trench is aimed at her wall? #moralstories #kids
title_alts: 🌊 Why does Nina's sand ridge keep slumping before the tide arrives? #moralstories #kids
🌊 The tide gives Nina one wave... and her dry ridge keeps slumping? #moralstories #kids
refrain: Pat it flat, pat it hard
description_hook: Nina has one wave left to make her sand wall survive, and the boy digging beside her is steering the sea right at it. Her fix is already lying on the beach.

characters.name: Nina
characters.description: seven years old, two braids, orange swim shirt, sandy knees

scenes.narration: Nina wanted her sand wall to survive one wave. The tide climbed.
scenes.caption: नीना चाहती थी कि उसकी रेत की दीवार एक लहर झेल ले। ज्वार चढ़ रहा था।
scenes.image_brief: Nina, a seven-year-old girl with two braids, an orange swim shirt and sandy knees, kneels on wet beach sand beside a low curved wall she has built around a small sandcastle, the foaming edge of the sea only a few steps behind her. Bright midday sun, wet shine across the flat sand.

scenes.narration: She heaped dry sand into a ridge. It slumped. Pat it flat, pat it hard.
scenes.caption: उसने सूखी रेत का ढेर बनाया। वह ढह गया। थपथपाओ चपटा, थपथपाओ कसकर।
scenes.image_brief: Nina, a seven-year-old girl with two braids, an orange swim shirt and sandy knees, heaps pale dry sand into a ridge with both hands on the beach while the top of the ridge collapses into a flat spill beside her fingers. Bright sunlight, broken shells scattered in the sand.

scenes.narration: Nina poured seawater over it. The ridge slid away. Pat along with me.
scenes.caption: नीना ने उस पर समुंदर का पानी डाला। ढेर बह गया। मेरे साथ थपथपाओ।
scenes.image_brief: Nina, a seven-year-old girl with two braids, an orange swim shirt and sandy knees, empties a small red bucket of seawater over her sand ridge on the beach and the ridge dissolves into a brown running puddle. Bright noon light, the open sea behind her.

scenes.narration: A boy dug a channel beside her. His trench aimed water at her wall.
scenes.caption: एक लड़के ने उसके पास नाली खोदी। उसकी खाई का पानी दीवार पर आ गया।
scenes.image_brief: A boy in blue shorts scoops a long channel through the sand a few steps from Nina, a seven-year-old girl with two braids, an orange swim shirt and sandy knees, and seawater runs down his trench straight towards her sand wall. Bright beach light, both children crouched and intent.

scenes.narration: Half the wall washed away. Four handfuls left.
scenes.caption: दीवार का आधा हिस्सा बह गया। सिर्फ चार मुट्ठी रेत बची।
scenes.image_brief: Half of Nina's sand wall is flattened into a shapeless smear of wet beach sand, and only a few handfuls of sand remain in her small red bucket. Nina, a seven-year-old girl with two braids, an orange swim shirt and sandy knees, kneels over the damage with open hands. Hard bright midday sunlight.

scenes.narration: Nina packed wet sand and torn seaweed in layers. Pat it flat, pat it hard, she said.
scenes.caption: नीना ने गीली रेत और टूटी सिवार परतों में दबाई। थपथपाओ चपटा, थपथपाओ कसकर, वह बोली।
scenes.image_brief: Nina, a seven-year-old girl with two braids, an orange swim shirt and sandy knees, presses a layer of wet sand down over a mat of torn brown seaweed on her rebuilt beach wall, with more seaweed strands piled at her knee. Bright sun, her face focused and determined.

scenes.narration: The boy braided seaweed while Nina packed. The wave hit and the wall stayed.
scenes.caption: लड़के ने सिवार गूँथी और नीना ने रेत दबाई। लहर आई और दीवार टिकी रही।
scenes.image_brief: The boy in blue shorts twists brown seaweed strands into a rope while Nina, a seven-year-old girl with two braids, an orange swim shirt and sandy knees, packs wet sand over them, and a wave breaks white against the finished wall without moving it. Bright spray lit by the sun.

scenes.narration: Nina patted the top twice. Pat with me. Pat it flat, pat it hard.
scenes.caption: नीना ने चोटी दो बार थपथपाई। मेरे साथ थपथपाओ। थपथपाओ चपटा, थपथपाओ कसकर।
scenes.image_brief: Nina, a seven-year-old girl with two braids, an orange swim shirt and sandy knees, pats the top of the finished seaweed-and-sand wall twice with a flat palm and laughs, the boy in blue shorts grinning beside her. Late afternoon sun low over the water, joyful mood.

title: 🎽 Kabir yanks his partner forward and the whole pair tumbles... why? #storytime #kidsstories
title_alts: 🎽 How does Kabir win a ribbon... when both boys keep crashing? #storytime #kidsstories
🎽 Two falls for Kabir already... and one three-legged race remains? #storytime #kidsstories
description_hook: Kabir has one three-legged race left to win the ribbon, and every pull he gives puts both boys on the grass. Then he changes what he is chasing.

characters.name: Kabir
characters.description: eight years old, curly hair, green sports vest, one shoelace pulled loose

scenes.narration: This year Kabir wanted the three-legged ribbon. One race, one chance, one partner.
scenes.caption: इस साल कबीर को तीन-पैर दौड़ का रिबन चाहिए था। एक दौड़, एक मौका, एक साथी।
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, an eight-year-old boy with curly hair and a green sports vest, stands at a chalk start line on a school sports field with his right ankle tied by cloth to the left ankle of another boy in a white vest, both looking down the lane at a red ribbon on a pole. Bright morning sun, marker cones along the grass.

scenes.narration: Kabir yanked his partner forward, but they crashed onto the grass. Inside foot, outside foot, go. Say it with me.
scenes.caption: कबीर ने साथी को आगे खींचा, पर दोनों घास पर गिर पड़े। अंदर पैर, बाहर पैर, चलो।
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, an eight-year-old boy with curly hair and a green sports vest, sprawls sideways on the cut grass of the school sports field with the other boy in the white vest tangled across him, their ankles still tied together, grass clippings on their arms. Bright morning sun, other tied pairs running past behind them.

scenes.narration: Two pairs finished while they untangled. His partner's knee was scraped. One race remained.
scenes.caption: उलझन सुलझाते-सुलझाते दो जोड़ियाँ पहुँच गईं। साथी का घुटना छिल गया। एक दौड़ बची।
scenes.image_brief: Two tied pairs of children cross the far chalk finish line on the school sports field while Kabir, an eight-year-old boy with curly hair and a green sports vest, sits up unpicking the cloth from his ankle, the other boy in the white vest holding a grazed knee beside him. Bright morning sun, a teacher clapping far off.

scenes.narration: Kabir stopped wanting first place. He knotted their ankles with his shoelace. Inside foot, outside foot, go, he counted.
scenes.caption: कबीर ने पहला आना छोड़ा। फीते से टखने बाँधे। अंदर पैर, बाहर पैर, चलो, वह गिना।
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, an eight-year-old boy with curly hair and a green sports vest, kneels on the school sports field tying his own long shoelace in a firm knot around his ankle and the ankle of the boy in the white vest, both of them watching the knot. Bright morning sun, the empty lane stretching ahead.

scenes.narration: They crossed the line together, last but laughing. Chant it with me.
scenes.caption: दोनों साथ-साथ रेखा पार कर गए, सबसे पीछे पर हँसते हुए। मेरे साथ बोलो।
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, an eight-year-old boy with curly hair and a green sports vest, steps over the chalk finish line shoulder to shoulder with the boy in the white vest, their ankles laced together, both laughing with open mouths while the field behind them is already empty. Warm late morning sun on the grass.

scenes.narration: Kabir untied the lace and smiled at his partner. Inside foot, outside foot, go.
scenes.caption: कबीर ने फीता खोला और साथी को देखकर मुस्कुराया। अंदर पैर, बाहर पैर, चलो।
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, an eight-year-old boy with curly hair and a green sports vest, crouches on the school sports field unpicking the shoelace knot from the other boy's ankle and smiling up at him, the red ribbon still on its pole far behind them. Warm sunlight, calm and easy mood.

title: 🧢 Arun holds up both hands but the bowler looks straight past... why? #kidsstories #moral
title_alts: 🧢 Why is Arun still waiting... for one turn at bat tonight? #kidsstories #moral
🧢 Everyone bats except Arun... so what does he offer the game? #kidsstories #moral
refrain: One catch, one turn at bat
description_hook: Arun has stood at the edge of the lane game all evening and nobody has passed him the bat. Then the ball goes where nobody wants to reach.

characters.name: Arun
characters.description: nine years old, thin, oversized red cap, dusty sandals

scenes.narration: Nobody had passed Arun the bat all evening. He waited by the wall.
scenes.caption: पूरी शाम किसी ने अरुण को बैट नहीं दिया। वह दीवार के पास खड़ा रहा।
scenes.image_brief: Arun, a nine-year-old thin boy in an oversized red cap and dusty sandals, stands with his back against a pink plaster wall at the edge of a narrow street lane while four other children play cricket with chalk stumps drawn on the wall further down. Low golden evening light, long shadows across the lane.

scenes.narration: Arun held up both hands. One catch, one turn at bat, he called. The bowler looked past him.
scenes.caption: अरुण ने दोनों हाथ उठाए। एक कैच, एक बारी बैटिंग, वह बोला। गेंदबाज़ ने अनदेखा किया।
scenes.image_brief: Arun, a nine-year-old thin boy in an oversized red cap and dusty sandals, stands with both hands raised and cupped in the middle of the narrow street lane while the bowler, a taller child holding a worn tennis ball, turns his head the other way. Warm evening light, dust in the air.

scenes.narration: A taller boy took the next turn. Call for a catch with me.
scenes.caption: एक लंबा लड़का अगली बारी ले गया। मेरे साथ कैच के लिए आवाज़ लगाओ।
scenes.image_brief: A taller boy in a striped shirt takes the cricket bat and walks to the chalk stumps in the narrow street lane while Arun, a nine-year-old thin boy in an oversized red cap and dusty sandals, lowers his hands and steps back toward the wall. Golden evening light, the other children clapping for the taller boy.

scenes.narration: The ball bounced into the drain. The game stopped. No bat for anybody.
scenes.caption: गेंद उछलकर नाली में गिर गई। खेल रुक गया। अब किसी को बैटिंग नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A worn tennis ball floats in the dark water of an open roadside drain at the end of the narrow street lane, and five children including Arun, a nine-year-old thin boy in an oversized red cap and dusty sandals, stand in a ring above it doing nothing, the bat lying forgotten on the ground. Dim orange evening light.

scenes.narration: Arun asked something else. Not can I bat? What do you need? One catch, one turn at bat.
scenes.caption: अरुण ने कुछ और पूछा। बैटिंग नहीं, बल्कि तुम्हें क्या चाहिए? एक कैच, एक बारी बैटिंग।
scenes.image_brief: Arun, a nine-year-old thin boy with his oversized red cap now held in both hands, stands at the edge of the open drain in the narrow street lane speaking to the ring of children, his cap stretched open like a scoop. Dim orange evening light, all the other children turned toward him.

scenes.narration: He hooked the ball out with his cap. Arun fielded nine throws. They gave him the bat.
scenes.caption: उसने टोपी से गेंद बाहर खींच ली। अरुण ने नौ थ्रो रोके। उन्होंने उसे बैट दे दिया।
scenes.image_brief: Arun, a nine-year-old thin boy in dusty sandals, lifts his dripping oversized red cap out of the roadside drain with the wet tennis ball sitting inside it, and a moment later the taller boy in the striped shirt is pushing the cricket bat into Arun's hands in the narrow street lane. Last orange light of evening.

scenes.narration: Arun grinned under his cap. Say it with me. One catch, one turn at bat.
scenes.caption: अरुण अपनी टोपी के नीचे मुस्कुराया। मेरे साथ कहो। एक कैच, एक बारी बैटिंग।
scenes.image_brief: Arun, a nine-year-old thin boy in a damp oversized red cap and dusty sandals, stands at the chalk stumps in the narrow street lane holding the cricket bat over his shoulder and grinning widely, the other children spread out around him ready to field. Deep warm dusk light.
